Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal and are very keen to win your business and demonstrate our capabilities as a reliable, long-term partner. For this position, our offer includes a price of €16.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

We look forward to the opportunity of working together and building a successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220 shaft – lead time and terms
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your quote offer:DEMO-C1-0. Your standard lead time of 45 days does not fit our requirement for the PX series, so the delivery date needs to be part of your offer. What is your earliest lead time for SH-220?

Our reference quote  is EUR 19.90 per unit, DAP, 60 days payment and 35 days lead time. We are comparing complete packages, including delivery terms and payment days.

Could you also share a cost breakdown (material 1.4021, machining, overhead) and tell us whether a cheaper variant is possible?

Please see the attached alternative packages.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our main offer is a price of €16.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our technical team will prepare the requested cost breakdown and evaluate potential cheaper variants.

We can offer a comprehensive package with DAP delivery, 60 days payment, and an expedited 28-day lead time to fully support your PX series. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days and delivery DAP: €17.60 per unit.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220 – revised packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for the revised offer and the delivery schedule. The 35-day lead time works for us.

Our alternative is  at EUR 19.90 per unit, DAP, for this part SH-220.

On a total-cost basis, EXW freight from your site still weighs on your package. We have prepared three alternatives that give you more flexibility on lead time and delivery point in exchange for price. If a 42-day lead time eases your production planning, we can accept it.

We would also welcome the cost breakdown and any cheaper variant your technical team identifies.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your revised offer and for your team's work on the cost breakdown.

Your main proposal with a 42-day lead time and 60 days payment comes close to what we need. On a total-cost basis, freight from your site under EXW is still a noticeable part of our landed cost. move.subject: SH-220 – your quote offer:DEMO-J1-0
move.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quote offer:DEMO-J1-0 and the clear presentation.

We compare complete packages on a landed-cost basis, so price, payment terms and delivery point all count. At EUR 17.10, EXW and 30 days, your offer is currently not competitive in our evaluation.

We have attached three packages. Your 28-day lead time is valuable to us, and we can be flexible on the delivery date in exchange for a better price.

Could you share a rough cost breakdown for SH-220 in 1.4021, and let us know whether a cheaper variant is possible?

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
